_about: The quiz questions (Part 2 of every leaf). See CONTENT_GUIDE.md. Each question: id (unique number), levelId (which leaf, from levels.json), then a photo (image = photo id from photos.json) and/or a story card (scene + sceneIcon emoji), the question, exactly 4 answers, and the correct answer copied exactly. Questions are shown in the order of this file.
